query_text: my service canada account log in

messages.content: my service canada account log in

message.content:
To **log in to My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**, go to the MSCA sign-in page and use the same sign-in method you originally registered with: **GCKey**, **Interac® Sign-In Partner**, or a **provincial sign-in**.[2][4]

If you’re not sure which one to use:
- Use the option you registered with every time you sign in.[2]
- If you want to switch sign-in methods, you may need to register again with the new option.[2]

If you **haven’t registered yet**, MSCA lets you access services like EI, CPP, OAS, direct deposit updates, and more.[2][5] You may need an **Access Code** for registration, depending on the service you’re using.[1][3]

If you want, I can also give you:
- the **exact login steps**
- help choosing between **GCKey** and **bank sign-in**
- instructions for **forgot username/password**
